tools.name: get_platform_upload_limits
tools.description: Return verified video file size limits, recommended target sizes, resolutions, official source URLs, and pre-configured zero-upload SqueezeVid URLs for Discord, WhatsApp, Email (Gmail/Outlook), TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), and Telegram.

tools.name: calculate_compression_plan
tools.description: Calculate exact target video/audio bitrates with 5% container safety headroom, recommended resolution (never upscaling), quality assessment, copy-pasteable 1-pass and 2-pass FFmpeg commands, and the best SqueezeVid browser/cloud mode to fit a target size or platform upload cap.

tools.name: build_ffmpeg_command
tools.description: Generate a shell-safe, ready-to-run FFmpeg CLI command with flag explanations and a matching zero-upload SqueezeVid browser tool URL for common media tasks (compress, convert, to_gif, gif_to_mp4, extract_audio, trim, crop, mute, rotate, change_speed, reverse).

tools.name: recommend_squeezevid_tool
tools.description: Recommend the best SqueezeVid tool(s) and processing engine (Browser WASM <=2 GB, Large Browser WebCodecs Beta <=10 GB, Cloud <=10 GB, Canvas image, or browser PDF) for a user's media task, file size, format pair, privacy requirement, and locale.

tools.name: list_squeezevid_tools
tools.description: List SqueezeVid's enabled privacy-first browser and cloud media tools, file size limits, engines, supported formats, pricing summary, and direct URLs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_platform_upload_limits, list_squeezevid_tools · Private data: get_platform_upload_limits, recommend_squeezevid_tool, list_squeezevid_tools · Public sink: get_platform_upload_limits, calculate_compression_plan, build_ffmpeg_command · Destructive: build_ffmpeg_command, recommend_squeezevid_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_platform_upload_limits, list_squeezevid_tools · Private data: get_platform_upload_limits, recommend_squeezevid_tool, list_squeezevid_tools · Public sink: get_platform_upload_limits, calculate_compression_plan, build_ffmpeg_command · Destructive: build_ffmpeg_command, recommend_squeezevid_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
